svg.title: Reconnect ≠ restart recovery
svg.desc: Memory retention is not durable storage. 1 · Live client disconnects: Local state, own History and pending changes remain in memory. A disconnected synchronized client is not a local-only client. 2 · Reconnect the live session: Verify schema/session → reconcile → retry unconfirmed work. Confirm accepted work; mismatch or unsafe state can stop reconnect. 3 · Different path: process was lost: Load a saved client checkpoint, not just a server snapshot. Recovery requires epoch/GC protection, exact receipts and reservation. 4 · Recover only when protection is proven: Unresolved conditional outcome or unsafe recovery → stop and inspect. Current durable path is bounded; format-2 capture is not automatic recovery.
